title: Ask HN: I’m an FCC Commissioner proposing regulation of IoT security updates
author: SimingtonFCC
excerpt: Hi everyone, I’m FCC Commissioner Nathan Simington, and I’m here to discuss security updates for IoT devices and how you can make a difference by filing comments with the FCC.
